facts.title: grilled feta with asparagus chimichurri
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano or 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves
1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh red chili pepper or 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
4 ounce bundle flat-leaf parsley [or 1/2 cup finely-chopped leaves]
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 large red onion, cut into thin wedges
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
facts.yield_text: 2 to 4 as a salad, 8 as a party appetizer
facts.author: Deb Perelman
